title: The Hound of the Baskervilles (trimmed)
purpose: Real mystery control. Holmes and Watson establish a case; unanswered questions are intentional, not bugs.
notes: Gutenberg excerpt: opening chapters trimmed to ~900 words each.
Dr Mortimer's stick, the Baskerville legend setup — none of this should raise contradictions.
If the checker flags Holmes being late, or Watson guessing about a visitor, that is a false positive of the 'absence/inference' family.

tolerate.why: A detective opening is supposed to open threads: whose stick, what danger, who inherits.

must_not_fire.why: Holmes correcting Watson's inferences is the story working, not a canon clash.
